newsitem.title: USA: Cato March same-store sales up 7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cato March same-store sales up 7 pct.

text.p: Cato Corp said Thursday its sales for the five weeks ended April 5 were $53.8 million, an increase of six percent versus sales of $50.8 million for the five weeks ended April 6, 1996.
It said same-store sales for March, or sales in stores that were open and were not relocated or expanded during the last 15 months, increased seven percent.
Sales for the nine weeks ended April 5 were $91.3 million, an increase of six percent versus sales of $86.1 million a year ago. Year-to-date same-store sales increased seven percent.
